---
name: 🛡 Removal request
description: Request removal of a link, file or reference (legal or courtesy)

labels: ['removal-request']

> **For copyright claims, please use GitHub's official DMCA form instead:**
> https://github.com/contact/dmca — GitHub validates the notice and forwards it to us.
> Use this template for trademark, privacy/GDPR, court orders or courtesy requests.
> **Do not post sensitive personal data here** (issues are public).

**Type of request:**
- [ ] Copyright (please use the DMCA form instead: https://github.com/contact/dmca)
- [ ] Trademark
- [ ] Privacy / personal data (GDPR erasure) — e.g. my username in a hosted PGN
- [ ] Court order / other legal basis
- [ ] Courtesy request (no legal claim — we may still remove a link)

**Your name / organization and your role** (rights holder, authorized agent, affected person):

**Contact** (email or handle):

**Exact content in this repo to remove or change** (file path, line, or full URL):

**Where the original content lives** (source URL):

**Basis of the claim** — which right is affected and why (work, mark, personal data, …):

**Proof of standing / evidence** (link to registration, license, profile, …):

**Requested action:**
- [ ] Remove the link
- [ ] Remove/replace the file
- [ ] Anonymize (e.g. remove username from PGN sample)
- [ ] Other: ___

**Good-faith statement:** I believe in good faith that the use of the content identified
above is not authorized by the rights holder, its agent, or the law.

**Signature / date:**
